name: bash-gloss
description: Plain-English gloss under each Bash call, written by a local Ollama model. No Claude tokens.

host.title: Ollama host
host.description: Base URL of your Ollama server.

model.title: Ollama model
model.description: Name of a model you have pulled in Ollama, e.g. nemotron-3-nano:4b or llama3.2.

dialogNotice.title: Also show under the permission dialog
dialogNotice.description: Experimental. Adds the gloss as a line under the Allow this bash command dialog.
